Agent Name: Orchestrator
, Step Number: 10
, Reason for Mistake: The Orchestrator incorrectly concluded that the Bing search results constituted supermarkets “within 2 blocks” of Lincoln Park without verifying actual distances or prices. This led to including locations (e.g., Trader Joe’s at 44 E Ontario and Whole Foods/Mariano’s on Kingsbury/Clybourn) that are not within 2 blocks of the park and to incomplete price validation (only partially checked via Instacart for Mariano’s).
